text:
anita: heads-up: onboarding smoke in sample-app hit a weird JSON-mode toolcall case. go-sdk's union normalizer turned a null into `{}` which later caused our sample handlers to blow up.

leo: ouch. can you drop the minimal schema + the raw model output?

anita: sure. schema (trimmed):
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "items": {
      "oneOf": [
        { "type": "array", "items": {"type":"object"} },
        { "type": "object", "properties": {"meta":{"type":"string"}} }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
raw model resp: `{"items": null}`

anita: go normalizer path `sanitizer.normalizeUnion()` coerced `null -> {}` because it tried to pick the non-array branch as fallback.

carol: is that because the code assumes empty object for missing struct? we had similar in the py-sdk but handled null specially.

harry: quick idea: prefer preserving literal null unless schema explicitly has `default` or a non-nullable requirement. Normalizer should only fabricate empty structures when we definitely mean to (compat flags?).

leo: agree. also add a unit test to ensure union[array,object] + model null => returns null. That prevents regressions for other SDKs.

anita: working on patch. I added a flag `preserveNullInUnion` default true so we can opt-out for older compat cases. PR: https://git.redwood/s/sdk-go/normalize-union-preservenull (WIP).

devex-bot: PR opened by anita: normalize-union-preservenull (WIP). CI queued build 7812.

carol: add a sample-app smoke test that runs the fncall with JSON-mode + auth retry to catch combinatorial failures. Learned the hard way last time.

harry: also ping eng-runtime if the server-side fncall shim has any legacy compat-mapping for nulls -> {}. If server is already converting, we might get surprises.

anita: good point. filed ENGRT-943 to check server-side casting rules.

leo: once PR green, cut a patch for go-sdk and cherry-pick into release branch. note in changelog: "fix: preserve null for union branches in json-mode fncall normalizer".

anita: CI red initially due to flaky samplekit test unrelated, rerun succeeded. final green. releasing go-sdk v0.5.9. rolling notification to onboarding teams.

carol: nice. follow-up: add a fuzz test for random union combinations + nulls so future sanitizer changes get broader coverage.

harry: thanks for catching this early in onboarding flow — saved a lot of confusion. :raised_hands:

anita: will add the fuzz job + update docs note about SDK behavior in JSON mode. closing RSVP. :sparkles:
